note: Nowata County, OK publishes no queryable zoning district layer. The City of Nowata, the county's largest city, publishes its zoning only as a map image/PDF and district documents on Google Drive links (R-1A, R-1B, R-1, R-2, C-1/C-2, I-L/I-H, mobile home park), not as a polygon service. The county's ArcGIS services (Nowata_County_Data on services.arcgis.com, OU CSA warehouse) hold only transportation, legislative, municipal and hydrology layers. Commercial parcel data has zoning fields almost entirely unpopulated.
